dedupe_keys.name: cmmb covid 19 health facility preparedness assessment for 253 facilities in haiti kenya peru south sudan and zambia hdx

description: This dataset records a survey of the preparedness of 253 partner health facilities of the Catholic Medical Mission Board to prevent and respond to COVID-19, carried out in April 2020 in Haiti, Kenya, Peru, South Sudan and Zambia, with a follow-up of 242 facilities in November 2021; 213 facilities were assessed twice. Questions cover medical equipment and supplies, training, waste disposal, infection prevention and control practices, triage and isolation, water and sanitation, and operations and accessibility. Coverage is the five countries' partner facilities, many of them rural and faith-based. The survey data are free to download as an Excel file from the Humanitarian Data Exchange under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the sample is the organisation's partner network, not a national frame, answers are self-reported, and the organisation is now marked inactive on HDX. Simulation uses: setting facility-level readiness and supply baselines in pandemic surge and health supply chain models for low-resource settings, and comparing preparedness before and after a response. Related records: the oxygen systems study in 39 low- and middle-income countries (case_study-oxygen-systems-39-lmics-facility-assessment) and HeRAMS (data-herams-health-resources-and-services-availability-monitoring-system-p02620) cover related readiness measures.
